items.title: Berkshire trims Bank of America, Capital One stakes, adds to Delta investment
items.summary: Investment.com -- Berkshire Hathaway reshuffled its equity portfolio in the third quarter, cutting its exposure to Bank of America and Capital One while increasing its investment in Delta Air Lines and building a new position in Italian technology company Bending Spoons, a regulatory filing showed on Monday.

items.title: Daniel Loeb’s Third Point Returned to Nvidia Stock Just Before Its Fall
items.summary: The fund’s third quarter filing shows a Nvidia stake of 1,500,000 shares.

items.title: Berkshire Boosts Lennar, Starts Bending Spoons, Trims Bank Of America In Q3
items.summary: According to the company’s filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission on Monday, the firm’s overall equity portfolio stood at roughly $304 billion across about 30 positions as of the end of the quarter.

items.title: Here's What Berkshire Hathaway Bought and Sold in Q3
items.summary: Berkshire mostly continued where it left off in Q2. Here are all the stocks that Greg Abel & Co. added to the portfolio — and the ones they sold, too.

items.title: Berkshire Hathaway Slashes This Top 5 Stock; Nvidia Boosts SpaceX
items.summary: Details of Berkshire Hathaway's Q3 buys and sells came in a 13F filing after Monday's close.

items.title: Warren Buffett’s Berkshire Just Sold More of One of Its Five Biggest Stocks. 57.8 Million Shares Are Gone Since March
items.summary: Berkshire Hathaway's new 13F shows 455,860,908 Bank of America shares on September 30, down 27,533,107 in three months and 57,763,257 in six.
